new_value: Fixed in 76a4a7d: both error lines moved to stderr; identity lines stay on stdout. Verified by running with personad down -- stdout is 0 lines, the error appears on stderr, and timeout kills it at exit 124, i.e. it was still polling. The give-up question was decided by Mark: watch never terminates on its own. A daemon restart must not kill a watch someone is reading, and the fail-open hazard needs a command to exit before it can mislead, which watch does not. No threshold, no knob. 'no identity' stays on stdout as an observed state.
